messages.text:
7/10 broth: flavour profile is nice but overall taste slightly bland, +0.3 if soya sauce added.

6.5/10 noodle: firm but clumped together. Slight soapy/alkaline taste. +2 if add Chili.

6.8/10 wontons: uneven skin distribution, would not recommend if you are into fried wonton. Juicy bouncy nicely executed prawn piece inside (very big chunks).

7.3/10 sliced beef: juicy and tender, cooked to a good level but not overly well done. Restaurant to be more generous with their portion.

6.9/10 minced fish ball: rather strange but unique concoction of meats in a ball. Strange shredded vegetable discovered inside the meatball which added to the unorthodox flavour. Lumpy texture was strangely appealing. Would recommend to try it at least once. 

4.5/10 vegetables with oyster sauce: sauce was fishy and much effort was required to uncover the leaves of the vegetables.

8/10 complimentary chili oil: wild.

Overall: 6.95/10. Ordered water but was almost served tea. Restaurant was awarded Michelin until 2020🤨

text:
Dear all, there was an attempt by suspicious individuals to invade this group by sending scam links and invitations to collect free furniture/items from different locations. The addresses of the individuals being highlighted are actually victims of loan shark harassments, and their personal details have been leaked out to the public.

We strongly advise to not engage with these individuals for your personal safety, instead tag

which will alert each of the admin and we will ban all the recalcitrant individuals from this group.

We apologise for the inconvenience caused by certain individuals who find joy in bringing chaos to our close-knit community, and hope you will join us in creating a more vibrant SMU community together!


P.S.: Enjoy your summer holidays too and congratulations to students who are about to graduate!

messages.text:
This is why we can't have nice things :( Bad apples who ruin honour systems. 

Thinking out loud, but I wonder if it would be helpful to have some sort of system to print a sign-in sheet where ppl sign in w their names and the collected qty. 
Just to hv some sort of accountability as an extra step so ppl don't feel like they can get away w being greedy during collection, and hopefully makes ppl think twice. Also so that the person who gives the food away can see how many ppl collected at the end, or so the ppl that are in the queue later can hv some data on how many ppl collected earlier.
